backgroundRecommend.customTexture: Custom texture detected — blending it into the background is preferred.
backgroundRecommend.imagePdf: Image mode suits a light scan base: keeps the paper feel without stealing focus.
backgroundRecommend.upload: Result pages over an uploaded file suit a subtle paper grain.
backgroundRecommend.structure: Structure-divergence samples suit blue + grid — more lab-like and easier to tell apart.
backgroundRecommend.hidden: Hidden-text samples suit a light paper base so white text stays invisible.
backgroundRecommend.action: Action/incremental samples suit the old-document/photocopy look.

good.title: Great contrast
good.detail: Body and background separate clearly — ready to generate.

warn.title: Fair contrast
warn.detail: Readable, but widen background/body colors a bit more.

alert.title: Low contrast
alert.detail: Body and background are too close; adjust colors or opacity.

backgroundComboNote.default: Using {theme} + {texture}; dark backgrounds auto-brighten the body and hidden white text follows the background.
backgroundComboNote.custom: Using {theme} + {texture} · {placement}; dark backgrounds auto-brighten the body and hidden white text follows the background.

annotation.title: Annotation

acroform.detail: AcroForm / text field found — possible hidden form payload.

ocg.title: Optional content group

actualtext.title: ActualText
actualtext.detail: ActualText found — copy results may differ from what eyes see.

structure.title: Structure tree / Tagged PDF

alttext.title: Alt text
alttext.detail: Alt text found — helper structures may carry extra content.

outlines.title: Outlines
outlines.detail: Bookmark structure found — extra text may be in outline titles.

pagelabels.title: Page labels

openaction.title: OpenAction
openaction.detail: OpenAction found — extra actions may run when the file opens.

javascript.title: JavaScript action

renderMode3.title: Non-drawn text
renderMode3.detail: Text Render Mode 3 found — text exists but is never painted.

cropbox.title: Crop difference

incremental.title: Incremental update
incremental.detail: Prev pointer found — the PDF has incremental sections.

object.title: Objects
object.note: Click an object to preview it — locate inject objects, fonts, streams and annotations.

output.title: Text output
output.note: Copy into other detection tests, or export with the package.

reasons.normalBaseline: Control sample — no hidden text added.
reasons.normalChannelCaveat: Although the mode is a control, extra channels still write content into the file structure.
reasons.normalConsistent: Page and extracted text stay consistent — a clean baseline.
reasons.hiddenWhiteText: 1pt white text appended at the page bottom.
reasons.hiddenExtractors: Most extractors still pass this hidden text to downstream models.
reasons.tounicodeType3: The footer uses Type3 glyphs shown normally to eyes.
reasons.tounicodeSplit: Extraction is controlled by the ToUnicode map, so it diverges from the visible footer.
reasons.imageOcrLayer: The image fills the page, with an OCR text layer on top.
reasons.uploadPreserve: The uploaded file is preserved as-is, no result pages appended.
reasons.uploadControl: A control sample for the upload scenario.
reasons.uploadPlacement: All original pages kept; result pages inserted {placement}.
reasons.uploadHiddenNote: Appended pages use white-text hiding — the most common trick.
reasons.uploadTounicodeNote: Appended pages use a true ToUnicode mismatch for eye/machine footer divergence.
